source.note: P1 remains backup/non-search. v0.3 separates proper noun 微月光 from generic 微光意象.

purpose: 以 LOC8 固定時期比較 LOC3 關鍵字 document frequency，並嚴格區分專有名詞、一般意象與其他語義標籤。

rules: 微月光 is a canonical LOC3 proper noun and must not be conflated with generic light imagery.
微光意象 is generic imagery and is not an alias of 微月光.
A work receives 微月光 only from explicit source evidence such as ERA_MOONLIGHT, era_name, playlist, title or explicit tag.
LOC8 owns period boundaries; LOC3 owns keyword semantics; LOC7 may index the result.

normalized_frequency_method.definition: Count each keyword at most once per work, divided by total works in that period.

transition_rules.formula: works containing keyword / total works in period

thresholds.persistent: previous >= 20% and current >= 20% and absolute change < 10 percentage points

transition_rules.low_sample_note: P8 currently has 2 works; P7→P8 labels are exploratory.
